newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-C.BANK SAYS REPO AUCTIONS WILL START IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-C.BANK SAYS REPO AUCTIONS WILL START IN JUNE.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Wednesday that repo auctions will likely start early next month.
"We will examine the liquidity situation every week in May with an eye to launching the repo auctions," the director of the bank's policy department, Gitanas Nauseda, told Reuters.
"But they will most likely start at the beginning of next month," he said.
Nauseda said that the country's banking sector had excess liquidity at the moment and the central bank feared an auction now would attract little interest.
"The banks also have to get ready for the move and we must give them some time," Nauseda added.

Nauseda said the central bank forecasts that the country's banks will experience liquidity problems in early June when the holiday season starts and people start withdrawing more cash from their accounts.
"It might be about right time to influence the market," he said.
Starting repo auctions is the first stage of the bank's plan to eventually regain the monetary policy instruments it lost when Lithuania adopted the currency board model in 1994.
